verification.note: Traced by reading the code. frontend/src/components/ImageCanvas.tsx:21-22 computes poster = has_thumbnail && paintedId !== file.id. paintedId is only ever set at line 31, inside the decode resolution and only when currentId matches. The file.id effect at lines 37-46 resets `decoded` but never clears paintedId. ImageCanvas is rendered without a key (FilePreview.tsx:160), so its state survives a change of file. Sequence A decodes -> B (not decoded yet) -> A: paintedId is still 'A', so poster is null from A's first render back, while the img is at opacity 0 (decoded=false). A's thumbnail is not painted again, which contradicts I8. The existing tests (ImageCanvas.test.tsx:135-171) only go f1 -> f2 and never return to a file that was already decoded.

Traced by reading the code. backend/app/services/scanner.py:217-227 makes _is_flattened_transparent_picture return False when another row on the same drive points at the same thumbnail_path. The elif chain at scanner.py:514/526 then reaches _is_letterboxed_image_thumbnail. When that returns True, line 536-537 writes gen_fn, which get_thumbnail_generator (thumbnail.py:624-625) returns as generate_image_thumbnail. generate_image_thumbnail (thumbnail.py:483-486) now writes WebP whenever carries_transparency(source) is True. So a transparent picture in a shared, letterboxed slot gets a WebP written into that shared slot. The letterbox branch already rewrote shared slots before this change, but only with JPEG; writing WebP into a shared slot is new, and it goes against the stated purpose of the shared-slot guard and against I11 if the letterbox rewrite counts as part of the migration.

specification_compliance: I8 is not met when the canvas returns to a file whose decode already resolved, before any other file's decode has resolved (F1).
I11 is bypassed through the letterbox branch for transparent sources in shared slots (F2), if that branch counts as part of the migration.
potential_unspecified_behavior: Whether I11's 'the migration' covers the pre-existing letterbox rewrite branch is not stated.
regression_risks: The letterbox branch in scanner.py now changes thumbnail format through generate_image_thumbnail, which the shared-slot guard does not cover.
test_coverage: ImageCanvas tests cover f1 -> f2 but not a return to a file that was already decoded (A -> B -> A).
I saw no test that covers a shared slot that is also letterboxed.
not_verified: I ran no tests and executed nothing; every result comes from reading the code.
